intent_en: To illustrate the decline in IRS budget, staffing, and audit volume following the 2010 election.
previous_intent: To illustrate the decline in IRS budget, revenue agents, and annual audits following the 2010 election and subsequent budget cuts.
narration_support: began aggressively cutting the agency's budget... number of auditors on staff has decreased... performing way fewer audits
chart_support: Three line charts showing downward trends for IRS Budget, IRS Revenue Agents, and IRS Audits Per Year from 2010 to 2015.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly links the 2010 election to budget cuts, staff decreases, and fewer audits. The three charts visually confirm these three metrics (Budget, Revenue Agents, Audits) all declining over the same period.
